Played in first person. 3D. You can name your character.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.
"

7: ## Linux browser and WebGPU capture

10: - Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
11: - Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
12: - Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D first-person RPG about climbing a 100-floor tower.

## Requirements
- Include character naming and customization, RPG stats with distributable points, difficulty, bosses, powers, NPCs with distinct dialogue, weapons, armor, relics, item rarity, sound effects, and language selection.
- Make the game substantial and time-consuming to complete, with a minimalist interface.

## Decisions
- Implemented the game as a single-page `index.html` using Three.js from jsDelivr and browser-local save data.
- Included English and Spanish interface options, three difficulty levels, desktop and touch controls, and procedural interface sounds.

## Work State
### Completed
- Built the 3D tower RPG with floor progression, combat, enemies and floor guardians, NPC trading/dialogue, leveling and stat points, loot/equipment, powers, potions, settings, and autosave.
- Checked the inline module syntax with `node --check`.
- Opened the game in Playwright, started a new game, verified the 3D scene rendered, and opened the character/status panel.
- Saved a gameplay screenshot at `screenshots/ascent.png`.

### Active
- No active edits; the build request is implemented.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Optionally continue browser testing of inventory, settings/language switching, combat, and floor progression; consider addressing the favicon 404 seen during testing.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Complete game implementation.
- `screenshots/ascent.png`: Captured gameplay view.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- Browser console showed a missing `/favicon.ico` 404 and SwiftShader rendering warnings; no game JavaScript errors were observed.
